focal_blueprints.title_zh: 超参数敏感性与极端噪声鲁棒性分析段（Sensitivity & Robustness Analysis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回应审稿人最常问的：你的模型是不是对超参数很敏感？在缺失值或传感器强噪声下会不会突然崩盘？
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Experiments 第 4.4 节 Sensitivity & Robustness
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [分析目的 Objective]：We further examine sensitivity to key hyperparameters and resilience against severe sensor corruption in Figure 4.

S2 [超参数平坦区间 Plateau Stability]：Varying [Hyperparameter $\lambda$] across two orders of magnitude ($[0.01, 1.0]$) alters validation MSE by less than [1.8%], demonstrating a wide stable operating plateau.

S3 [极端边缘工况压力测试 Stress Test under Corruption]：Under synthetic sensor dropouts up to [40%] and Gaussian noise ($\sigma=0.3$), baseline accuracy plummets by over [35%], whereas our model degrades by less than [6.5%].
S4 [鲁棒性物理归因 Robustness Mechanism]：This resilience stems from [Specific Mechanism], which filters out corrupted channels before global aggregation.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Goal -> Wide Hyperparameter Plateau -> Stress-Test Comparison -> Mechanistic Explanation. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L019.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Figure 4 shows hyperparameter sensitivity. When lambda changes from 0.1 to 1.0, the result does not change much. Also, when we add noise, our model is still very stable.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 模糊口语（does not change much, still very stable），缺乏量化波动范围与抗噪机理。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Figure 4 evaluates hyperparameter sensitivity and resilience against severe observation corruption. Varying the phase regularization weight $\lambda$ across $[0.05, 0.50]$ alters validation MSE by less than 1.4%, indicating a wide, tuning-friendly operating plateau around $\lambda=0.15$. Under stress tests where 30% of sensor readings are randomly masked or corrupted by impulse noise ($\text{SNR} = 5\text{ dB}$), point-wise Transformer baselines suffer a 34.2% error surge, whereas DyTS-Net degrades by only 4.8%. This robustness stems from our spectral energy gate, which automatically attenuates high-entropy corrupted channels prior to cross-variate message passing.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 异常数据点（Outliers）与局部背离现象精准批注段（Outlier & Anomaly Annotation）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在图表或实验结果段中，专门挑出违背总体规律的 1–2 个异常点（Outliers）或局部反常尖峰进行精准描述与成因剖析。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 特例段 / 论文实验反常现象（Anomalous Observation）剖析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [总体规律背景下的特例锚定 Outlier Identification]：Although [General Trend holds across most groups/steps], a notable departure from this pattern occurs in [Specific Point/Group].
S2 [反常幅度量化 Quantitative Deviation]：Whereas peer categories cluster tightly within $[A, B]$, [Outlier Entity] spikes/drops to [Extreme Value], deviating by more than [X%] from the group median.
S3 [底层物理/统计成因剖析 Root Cause Analysis]：Closer inspection indicates that this anomaly stems from [Specific Structural/External Factor] rather than random variance.
S4 [方法论启示 Methodological Implication]：Accounting for such localized departures is critical when calibrating [Downstream Model/Policy].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: General Rule vs. Notable Departure -> Quantitative Deviation -> Root Cause Attribution -> Calibration Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L013.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Most datasets follow this rule, except Exchange dataset. On Exchange dataset, deep models are worse than simple linear models. This is because financial data has strong random walk noise.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 表达平淡（follow this rule, except, worse than），缺乏量化的偏离描述与深层统计定性。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Although deep spectral transformers outperform linear baselines across six of the seven benchmarks, a notable departure emerges on the financial Exchange-Rate dataset. Whereas complex attention models reduce MSE by 12%–18% on periodic energy and weather streams, they trail a single-layer DLinear baseline by 4.3% on Exchange-Rate. Autocorrelation analysis reveals that this reversal stems from the near-martingale nature of daily currency returns, where weak seasonal periodicity causes high-capacity attention layers to overfit transient market shocks. This anomaly confirms that model capacity must be matched to the intrinsic signal-to-noise ratio of the underlying stochastic process.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 全局总括与新增实验汇总段（Author Rebuttal General Response）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Author Rebuttal 置顶总括段（Official Global Response）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [致谢并提炼审稿人共同好评 Gratitude & Shared Praise]：We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our work's [Quote Reviewer 1 Praise] (R1), [Quote Reviewer 2 Praise] (R2), and [Quote Reviewer 3 Praise] (R3).

S2 [概览新增实证工作 Overview of New Experiments]：In response to your valuable suggestions, we have conducted [N] sets of new experiments and theoretical analyses, summarized below and highlighted in blue in the revised PDF:

S3 [分条列出硬核新增实验 Bullet Summary of Additions]：(1) Added comparisons against recent baselines [A, B] on [Dataset] (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Evaluated real-world robustness under [Harsh Condition] (Appendix D, R2); (3) Provided wall-clock latency and memory profiling across sequence lengths up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R3).
S4 [诚挚收束 Closing Courtesies]：We address each specific question in the individual responses below and welcome any further discussion.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Synthesize Reviewer Praise -> Announce Concrete Revisions -> Numbered Evidence Bullets mapped to Reviewers -> Courteous Hook. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Thank you to all reviewers for your time and comments. We have carefully read your reviews and answered all your questions below. We hope you can raise your scores.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 空洞客套且直接讨要分数（hope you can raise your scores），没有在第一眼展示任何新增实证工作量。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our framework's 'principled formulation of the stationarity-amplitude trade-off' (R1, R3), 'strong empirical gains across eight benchmarks' (R2), and 'clear ablation design' (R4). To address your valuable suggestions, we conducted four sets of new experiments during the rebuttal period (incorporated in blue in the revised manuscript): (1) Benchmarked against two latest 2025 foundation models, Chronos and MOIRAI, across all horizons (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Added real-robot grasping evaluations under dynamic lighting and 25% camera occlusion (Section 4.5, R2); and (3) Included full GPU memory and wall-clock latency scaling curves up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R4). Below we address each reviewer's specific questions in detail.

focal_logic_rules.category: Exam Essays (六级/雅思/托福论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 反事实假设论证法（Counterfactual Reasoning in Exam Essays）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 在六级、雅思 Task 2 和托福独立写作中，当正面说理写满两句感觉词穷时，立即引入一句“反事实推演（Absent this policy / Without such regulation / Were universities to abandon X）”：指出如果缺失该条件，会引发什么具体负面连锁反应，从而反向锁死中心论点。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Positive Mechanism S1-S2]. Conversely, without [Core Factor X], [System/Individuals] would inevitably face [Concrete Negative Outcome Y], as seen when [Real-World Scenario Z].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 正面车轱辘话来回重复三遍（X is important. Therefore we must do X because X is very beneficial to society.）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Independent critical thinking is very important for college students in the AI era. Students should think independently so that they can have a bright future.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Training students to verify algorithmic outputs against primary sources cultivates rigorous analytical judgment. Without this verification habit, undergraduates risk accepting plausible-sounding AI hallucinations as factual premises, eroding their capacity to diagnose complex engineering failures.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 第一句正面阐述“核查一手文献培养分析判断力”，第二句用 Without this verification habit... 反推不核查带来的具体后果（把逼真的 AI 幻觉当成事实前提），论证立体深刻。

focal_logic_rules.category: Logical Fallacy Prevention (逻辑谬误防范)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 诊断与修复逻辑跳跃（Bridging Logical Leaps / Missing Premises）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Diagnosing and Bridging Missing Logical Premises
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 作者脑子里清楚 A -> B -> C，但写出来只写了 A，紧接着就 wrote Therefore, C。修改时必须站在审稿人/读者视角，把隐含的中间桥接前提 B（Missing Premise）显式补写出来。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Premise A: [Observation]. -> Missing Bridge B: [Because A implies Property B under Condition K], -> Conclusion C: [Therefore, Design/Policy C is necessary].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 滥用 Therefore / Thus / Hence 强行连接两句根本没有直接推出关系的话。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Industrial time series contain missing values at irregular intervals. Therefore, we use a continuous-time neural ODE encoder.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Industrial sensor streams frequently suffer from irregular missing timestamps due to packet loss. Because standard discrete-step RNNs assume uniform sampling intervals and distort time-delta dynamics when inputs are missing, we model latent state evolution between arbitrary observation times using a continuous-time neural ODE.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 补全了关键中间前提：“离散步长 RNN 默认等间隔采样，在缺失值下会扭曲时间间隔动力学”，从而让引入连续时间神经 ODE 变得顺理成章。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 多模态灵巧操作与力触觉闭环反馈
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想回应审稿人最常问的：你的模型是不是对超参数很敏感？在缺失值或传感器强噪声下会不会突然崩盘？
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Figure 4 shows hyperparameter sensitivity. When lambda changes from 0.1 to 1.0, the result does not change much. Also, when we add noise, our model is still very stable.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L020 反事实假设论证法（Counterfactual Reasoning in Exam Essays））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 模糊口语（does not change much, still very stable），缺乏量化波动范围与抗噪机理。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Figure 4 evaluates hyperparameter sensitivity and resilience against severe observation corruption. Varying the phase regularization weight $\lambda$ across $[0.05, 0.50]$ alters validation MSE by less than 1.4%, indicating a wide, tuning-friendly operating plateau around $\lambda=0.15$. Under stress tests where 30% of sensor readings are randomly masked or corrupted by impulse noise ($\text{SNR} = 5\text{ dB}$), point-wise Transformer baselines suffer a 34.2% error surge, whereas DyTS-Net degrades by only 4.8%. This robustness stems from our spectral energy gate, which automatically attenuates high-entropy corrupted channels prior to cross-variate message passing.

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）与消融防御
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的结尾段（Conclusion）：用 2–3 句话收束全文，做到既呼应中心论点、整合正反权衡，又绝不喊假大空口号（Let us work together for a better tomorrow）。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: In conclusion, AI has both advantages and disadvantages. We should make full use of its advantages and avoid its disadvantages. Let us work hand in hand to welcome a bright future of AI!

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L010 定量实证三元组：指标 + 基线 + 边界条件（Metric-Baseline-Condition Triad））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 结尾段最忌讳的三句废话全中：既有好处也有坏处 + 扬长避短 + 让我们携手共创美好未来（口号感叹句）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: In conclusion, while automated decision systems inevitably introduce transitional labor friction and verification challenges, integrating them into industrial and academic workflows yields substantial long-term productivity gains. By pairing algorithmic deployment with transparent audit trails and targeted workforce retraining, institutions can capture efficiency breakthroughs without eroding human analytical oversight. Ultimately, the value of intelligent automation rests not on replacing human judgment, but on elevating the precision of the evidence upon which human judgment acts.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Among spectral forecasters, FEDformer and TimesNet are most closely related to our approach. While both methods transform temporal representations via fast Fourier transforms, they apply static top-k frequency selection globally across the entire lookback window, which blurs localized transient spikes. In contrast, our wavelet-coupled attention dynamically adapts filter bandwidths over sliding sub-intervals, isolating non-stationary burst events without corrupting global seasonal bases. Consequently, our model captures localized fault transients without requiring pre-defined frequency thresholds.
